newsitem.title: USA: Giddings & Lewis sets meeting for Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: Giddings & Lewis sets meeting for Sept 11.

text.p: Giddings & Lewis Inc said Tuesday its board of directors has set September 11 as the date for a special shareholder meeting in connection with Harnischfeger Industries Inc's hostile takeover bid.

Giddings said the company has received written demands that a meeting be called from holders of more than 10 percent of the company's outstanding common stock. Under the company's by-laws and the Wisconsin Business Corporation Law, a special meeting of shareholders must therefore be called.

Earlier Tuesday, Harnischfeger said a meeting must be held on September 5 based on its reading of Giddings' by-laws. It said the meeting would be called to, among other things, remove and replace Giddings' current board of directors.
In May, Harnischfeger launched a $19 a share hostile bid for Giddings. The Giddings board unanimously rejected the bid and termed it inadequate.
